correctness.rationale: In the exact one-sorted named-point/named-line incidence signature, rank-one extension types of triples are fixed by equality, sorts, incidence and common-neighbor (distance-two) flags. Girth at least twelve excludes competing short paths and three different pairwise length-two links without a common star center; thickness permits each one-neighbor branch, and the finite generalized-hexagon side-size formula supplies fresh nonadjacent extensions. Therefore rank-two ordered-pair types depend on distance truncated to equality/2/4/>=6 within sorts and 1/3/>=5 across sorts (2*4+2*3=14). Every root has all permissible pair types, giving two rank-three singleton and one rank-four sentence types. Generalized quadrangles have the same rank-three sentence types; the explicitly nested rank-four existential sentence detects an opposite-sort pair with no length-three incidence path, false in generalized quadrangles and true in hexagons/octagons. Rank-five equivalence is not asserted.
